entry.name: Quality
entry.label: Preferred download quality for Aerial videos

entry.name: TimeOfDay
entry.label: Restrict playback to videos shot at a given time of day
entry.whatsthis: All plays the whole catalog. Day covers Apple's day and sunrise footage, Night its night and sunset footage. MatchClock follows the desktop's own clock, switching between them as the day goes on.

entry.name: Shuffle
entry.label: Play Aerial videos in random order

entry.name: MaxCacheMB
entry.label: Maximum on-disk cache size for downloaded videos, in megabytes
entry.whatsthis: A 4K HDR clip is a few hundred megabytes, so the default holds roughly forty of them; a smaller budget means videos are evicted and re-downloaded as playback cycles.

entry.name: WifiOnly
entry.label: Only download new videos over Wi-Fi (unmetered) connections

entry.name: BlacklistedIds
entry.label: Aerial location ids excluded from playback
